statement: C3 trial: 30 tasks asked informally and formally to Qwen2.5-1.5B, scored blind to register. Formal did better in all four runs (greedy 19/30 vs 23/30, McNemar p=0.34; sampled p=0.039, 0.27, 0.016; pooled sign p=0.077). Toss-up leaning against the claim that informal asks do as well or better; small model, imitated register, n=30.
